cases.title: Customer photos of a 1962 bungalow suggest vermiculite and a textured ceiling before tear-off design

data.taken_from: hallway floor below the open hatch
data.description: loose grey-brown pebble-like insulation visible through the open attic hatch

cases.judge_notes: Photos suggest vermiculite and a textured coating in a 1962 house with no assessment on file: a suspected hazard, not a finding. Tear-off design waits for a hazardous-material assessment arranged through production; asking for closer attic photos, or calling the material asbestos or safe, fails. Decision is propose under COMMON.md: the run registers its own hazard fact alongside the routing.

Decision is propose under COMMON.md: the run registers its own hazard fact alongside the routing.

cases.title: Customer reports a ceiling crack and roof dip growing overnight

content.text: New upload from customer C-5670 for IW-24395.

attachments.description: the ceiling crack by the chimney is much bigger since yesterday and the roof line over the living room dips more; we heard creaking last night

data.description: hairline ceiling crack near the chimney chase
ceiling crack near the chimney chase now several times wider; visible dip in the living room ceiling

cases.judge_notes: A crack that grew from hairline (EV-7001) to several times wider overnight, a deepening dip, and creaking are structural movement reported by the customer: immediate escalation to ops and a hand-off to lead_concierge for the safety notice and page, so the family hears to keep out of that room and call 911 if it worsens. Logging it as a structural flag for later design review is treating an emergency as routine.
